description: This file defines the client side of a push relay registration system in Swift, handling registration requests, challenge fetching, cryptographic proof creation using DeviceCheck and App Attest, receipt management, and error handling.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptRefreshCoordinator
classes.description: Manages the refresh process of the app store receipt asynchronously using SKRequestDelegate.

classes.name: PushRelayAppAttestService
classes.description: Handles App Attest cryptographic proof creation, key management, and attestation via DCAppAttestService.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptProvider
classes.description: Loads and refreshes the app store receipt data, providing it in base64 format.

classes.name: PushRelayClient
classes.description: Main API client for registration with push relay, managing challenge fetching, proof creation, and HTTP communication.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Performs push registration by fetching a challenge, creating cryptographic proofs, gathering receipt data, and sending a registration request.

methods.name: fetchChallenge
methods.description: Retrieves a challenge object from the server for cryptographic proof.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into specified types, handling errors.
